verses.text: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
lines: My heart is steadfast, God.
I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

verses.text: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
lines: Wake up, harp and lyre!
I will wake up the dawn.

verses.text: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
lines: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations.
I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

verses.text: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
lines: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens.
Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

verses.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
lines: Be exalted, God, above the heavens!
Let your glory be over all the earth.

verses.text: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
lines: That your beloved may be delivered,
save with your right hand, and answer us.

verses.text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
lines: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph,
I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

verses.text: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
lines: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine.
Ephraim also is my helmet.
Judah is my scepter.

verses.text: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
lines: Moab is my wash pot.
I will toss my sandal on Edom.
I will shout over Philistia.”

verses.text: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?
lines: Who will bring me into the fortified city?
Who has led me to Edom?

verses.text: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
lines: Haven’t you rejected us, God?
You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

verses.text: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
lines: Give us help against the enemy,
for the help of man is vain.

verses.text: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.
lines: Through God, we will do valiantly.
For it is he who will tread down our enemies.
